content_zh:
展步冷哼，他能感觉到这箱子传来一阵阵令他不舒服的感觉，也不与这女人多说，直接伸手就要抢夺皮箱。
看到展步的动作，女人像是疯了一样，一把护住这箱子，然后大声吼道：“大家都来评评理，我不过是不小心撞了这女娃一下，她朋友竟然要留下我的箱子，还讲不讲理了。”
女孩身边的那个年轻人忽然说道：“大婶你误会了，我们不认识这个人，他拦住你和我们没关。”
女孩狠狠瞪了他一眼，嫌他胡乱说话，不过她也不知道展步为什么要拦住这女人，她见展步要与中年妇女抢箱子，急忙说道：“我真的没事，我也没丢钱。”
一听到钱，这女人急忙对展步说道：“对对，钱，我给你钱不行么，你别抢我箱子。”
女人的语气中有慌乱，也有哀求，甚至都带了一丝哭腔，让人不忍。
此时，不少人被这边的动静吸引，不少人看到一个大小伙子要夺一个女人的箱子，指责展步。
“你这人怎么回事？不过是碰了那女孩子一下，怎么就要夺人家箱子？”有人指责展步。
“就是啊，讹人也要有个限度，人家都说给你钱了，还想怎么着？”
这时候，展步忽然感到一阵烦闷，这箱子的存在让他感到一阵压抑。
展步知道，自己说什么都没用，现在只能但是整个身体表现出一种气弱之感，她胸部低垂，像极了暮年老鼠。
展步一惊，这种胸型与鹿首胸型是两个极端，是下下胸型，表示这女人将有牢狱之灾！
展步知道，这女人箱子里必然有不可告人的东西，否则不会想要拿钱出来让展步不要碰她的箱子，而且，她将有牢狱之灾，更说明这关系非同小可！
展步不再犹豫，一只手扣住女人的手臂，微微一拧就把这女人反拧了起来，然后一脚踢到女人的小腿，扑通一声女人跪倒在地上。
“啊……你干什么？耍流氓啊！”这女人杀猪般的大叫，一方面是疼的，另一方面是惊恐。
这个时候，不少围观的人都是一愣，展步的动作太麻利了，这可不像耍流氓，更像是便衣警察抓犯人一般，再说，展步看起来一个不到二十岁的小伙子，会对一个中年大妈耍流氓？
展步此时大喊一声：“闭嘴！”
然后展步回头看了一眼中年大叔：“叔，你帮忙把这箱子中年大叔虽然不知道怎么回事，但是展步的语气不容置疑，而且中年大叔识人无数，此时也看出这女人有点问题，随即一把拉过了大箱子：“密码箱……”
“密码多少？”展步问女人。
女人脸色发青，声音瑟瑟发抖：“我认错，我认错还不行么，你说要多少钱，我都给，把箱子还给我吧……”

女孩身边的年轻人本来就看展步不爽，这个时候急忙帮腔道：“是啊，你这人也太多管闲事了，我们与你不过是萍水相逢，连名字都还不知道，你就算献殷勤，未免太着急了吧。”
展步瞪了眼：“你给我闭嘴！我不缺那几百块钱，但是这箱子有问题，必须这个时候，车厢里其他人也觉得不对劲了，纷纷开口道：“”
听到有人这么说，旁边急忙有人附和：“对对对，展步头上飘过一道黑线，他妈的，感情这群人把自己当成缉毒犬了，你们他妈才鼻子灵呢！展步的心里仿佛有千万头牛牛跑过。
听到所有人都要求展步也不废话，让中年大叔手拿开，然后一脚踢在了密码锁上，一般的密码箱，锁都是塑料的，小锤子一敲就碎，展步本身就有武学底子，这一脚下去直接把密码锁踢了个粉碎。
中年大叔急忙个孔，中年大叔急忙把保温箱当箱子了嘴，然后一下子用手将自己的嘴捂住，显然是惊呆了。
中年大叔忽然低沉的怒吼：“造孽啊！快快快，赶快报警，这个女人是人贩子！”
人贩子！展步一回头，果然发现这保温箱里有两个不大的婴儿，但是婴儿脸色很不好，车厢里如此喧哗，这两个婴儿竟然还在沉睡，脸色发青。
此时不少人已经发现了，急忙去报警，中年大叔与女孩看向展步的眼神中更是不可思议，他们怎么也想不明白，展步是怎么发现的这女人不正常。
至于女孩旁边的年轻人更是脸上发烫，刚才他还装圣母给这人贩子说话呢。

Zhan Bu snorted coldly. He could feel the uncomfortable feeling coming from the suitcase. Without saying anything to the woman, he directly reached out to snatch the suitcase.
Seeing Zhan Bao's action, the woman seemed to be going crazy, protecting the box, and then shouted loudly: "Everyone is here to judge, I just bumped into this girl accidentally, and her friend wants to keep my box, and she is being unreasonable."
The young man next to the girl suddenly said: "Auntie, you misunderstood. We don't know this person. It has nothing to do with us that he stopped you."
The girl glared at him fiercely, hating him for talking nonsense, but she didn't know why Zhan Bu stopped the woman. When she saw Zhan Bu trying to grab the box with the middle-aged woman, she hurriedly said: "I'm really fine, I didn't lose any money."
As soon as she heard about the money, the woman hurriedly said to Zhan Bu: "Yes, money, can't I give you the money? Don't rob my box."
There was panic, pleading, and even a hint of crying in the woman's tone, which was unbearable.
At this time, many people were attracted by the movement here. Many people saw a young man trying to snatch a woman's box and accused Zhan Bu.
"What's wrong with you? You just touched that girl, why do you want to take her box?" Someone accused Zhan Bu.
"That's right, there must be a limit to blackmailing people. They've already said they'll give you money, so what else do you want?"
At this time, Zhan Bu suddenly felt bored. The existence of this box made him feel depressed.
Zhan Bu knew that it was useless to say anything. Now her whole body could only show a feeling of weakness. Her chest was drooping, like a mouse in its twilight years.
Zhan Bu was shocked. This breast shape was the opposite extreme of the deer-head breast shape. It was an under-breast shape, which meant that this woman would be imprisoned!
Zhan Bu knew that there must be something ulterior in this woman's box, otherwise she would not have wanted to pay Zhan Bu not to touch her box. Moreover, she would be imprisoned, which shows that this relationship is not trivial!
Zhan Bu no longer hesitated, clasped the woman's arm with one hand, twisted the woman back up with a slight twist, and then kicked the woman's calf, causing the woman to kneel on the ground with a plop.
"Ah... what are you doing? You're acting like a hooligan!" The woman screamed like a pig, feeling hurt on the one hand and frightened on the other.
At this time, many onlookers were stunned. Zhan Bu's movements were too quick. It didn't look like playing a gangster, but more like a plainclothes police arresting a criminal. Besides, Zhan Bu looked like a young man less than twenty years old, would he play a gangster on a middle-aged aunt?
Zhan Bu shouted at this time: "Shut up!"
Then Zhan Bu looked back at the middle-aged uncle: "Uncle, please help put this box in. Although the middle-aged uncle didn't know what was going on, Zhan Bu's tone was unquestionable, and the middle-aged uncle knew many people. At this time, he also saw that there was something wrong with this woman, and then he pulled the big box away: "The password box..."
"What's the password? "Zhanbu asked the woman.
The woman's face turned blue and her voice trembled: "I admit my mistake, why don't I admit my mistake? I'll pay you whatever you want. Just return the box to me..."
The young man next to the girl was already unhappy with Zhan Bu. At this time, he hurriedly said: "Yes, you are too nosy. We just met you by chance, and we don't even know your name. Even if you are attentive, you are too anxious. "
Zhan Bu glared: "Shut up! I am not short of the few hundred dollars, but there is something wrong with this box. At this time, other people in the carriage also felt that something was wrong, and they all said: ""
Hearing someone say this, someone next to him hurriedly echoed: "Yes, yes, there is a black line floating on Zhan Bu's head. Damn it, these people in Emotion regard themselves as drug detection dogs. You guys have a good fucking nose! Zhan Bu's heart seems to have thousands of cows running through it.
Hearing everyone's request for Zhanbu, he didn't waste any words and asked the middle-aged uncle toHe took it away, and then kicked it on the combination lock. The locks of ordinary combination boxes are made of plastic and can be broken when hit with a small hammer. Zhan Bu himself has a foundation in martial arts, so he kicked the combination lock to pieces.
The middle-aged uncle hurriedly opened his mouth. The middle-aged uncle hurriedly used the incubator as a box and covered his mouth with his hands. He was obviously shocked.
The middle-aged uncle suddenly roared in a low voice: "What a sin! Quick, quick, quick, call the police, this woman is a human trafficker!"
Human traffickers! When Zhan Bu turned around, he found that there were two small babies in the incubator, but the babies looked very bad. There was so much noise in the car, and the two babies were still sleeping, with their faces turning blue.
At this time, many people had discovered it and hurriedly called the police. The middle-aged uncle and the girl looked at Zhan Bu with incredible eyes. They couldn't figure out how Zhan Bu found out that this woman was abnormal.
As for the young man next to the girl, his face was even hotter. Just now he pretended to be the Holy Mother to speak to the trafficker.
